A sector has radius 6 cm and arc length 4pi cm. Find the angle.
items.imageAlt: A circle, centre O, radius 6 cm. The highlighted arc AB has length 4 pi cm. The angle at the centre is unknown, marked x.
hints: Rearrange arc length = (angle/360) x 2πr to solve for the angle.
4pi = (angle/360) x 2 x pi x 6 = (angle/360) x 12pi, so angle/360 = 4/12.

hints: Rearrange sector area = (angle/360) x πr^2 to solve for r.

items.q: A 90° sector of radius 6 cm has the triangle removed. Find the area of the segment.
items.imageAlt: A circle, centre O, radius 6 cm. A 90 degree sector OAB is shown with the chord AB drawn. The shaded segment, between the chord and the arc, is the region whose area is to be found.
hints: Segment area = sector area - triangle area.
Sector area = (90/360) x pi x 6^2 = 9pi; triangle area = (1/2)(6)(6)sin(90°) = 18.

items.q: A 60° sector of radius 12 cm has the triangle removed. Find the area of the segment.
items.imageAlt: A circle, centre O, radius 12 cm. A 60 degree sector OAB is shown with the chord AB drawn. The shaded segment, between the chord and the arc, is the region whose area is to be found.
hints: Segment area = sector area - triangle area.
Sector area = (60/360) x pi x 12^2 = 24pi; triangle area = (1/2)(12)(12)sin(60°) = 36sqrt(3).

items.q: A 180° sector of radius 5 cm has the triangle removed. Find the area of the segment.
hints: Segment area = sector area - triangle area — for a 180° sector, sin(180°) = 0, so no triangle is subtracted.
Sector area = (180/360) x pi x 5^2 = 25pi/2; triangle area = (1/2)(5)(5)sin(180°) = 0.

items.q: A 120° sector of radius 3 cm has the triangle removed. Find the area of the segment.
hints: Segment area = sector area - triangle area.
Sector area = (120/360) x pi x 3^2 = 3pi; triangle area = (1/2)(3)(3)sin(120°) = 9sqrt(3)/4.

items.q: A 90° sector of radius 4 cm has the triangle removed. Find the area of the segment.
hints: Segment area = sector area - triangle area.
Sector area = (90/360) x pi x 4^2 = 4pi; triangle area = (1/2)(4)(4)sin(90°) = 8.

items.q: A 60° sector of radius 6 cm has the triangle removed. Find the area of the segment.
hints: Segment area = sector area - triangle area.
Sector area = (60/360) x pi x 6^2 = 6pi; triangle area = (1/2)(6)(6)sin(60°) = 9sqrt(3).

items.q: A 90° sector of radius 6 cm. The segment's perimeter is the arc length plus the chord length (chord = 6sqrt(2) for a 90° sector). Find the perimeter.
hints: Add the arc length to the given chord length.
Arc length = (90/360) x 2 x pi x 6 = 3pi, so perimeter = 3pi + 6sqrt(2).
